kit_page.name: stylize_kit
kit_page.summary: Native ink lines traced over edges, with line, colour, sketch, pattern and motion. Pick a look, then tune it.

kit_row.help: Sets every Roto Ink setting to its default, which turns ink off.
kit_row.label: Reset all

kit_row.help: Black for classic ink, white for chalk, saturated for neon.
kit_row.label: Ink colour

kit_row.help: Multiplies the ink colour. Use 1 for classic ink; 4 to 16 for neon glow. HDR only.
kit_row.label: HDR intensity

kit_row.help: How opaque the ink is.
kit_row.label: Opacity

kit_row.help: Normal paints ink over the scene, Multiply only darkens, Add gives an HDR glow.
kit_row.label: Blend

kit_row.help: Where in the post chain the ink pass runs. Overlay skips bloom and grade.
kit_row.label: Layer

kit_row.help: Fixed uses the swatch. Match samples the brightest light just outside each edge.
kit_row.label: Colour from

kit_row.help: Sends the line into bloom, separately from the blend mode.
kit_row.label: Bloom feed

kit_row.help: How far outside the edge the match-light colour is sampled, in pixels at 1080p.
kit_row.label: Match px

kit_row.help: Outer outline where the subject meets whatever is behind it.
kit_row.label: Silhouette

kit_row.help: Strength of the silhouette line.
kit_row.label: Weight

kit_row.help: Line width in pixels at 1080p. Fractional widths are anti-aliased.
kit_row.label: Width px

kit_row.help: 0 is a hard line; 1 is a gradual fade on shallow steps and gentle creases.
kit_row.label: Softness

kit_row.help: Lines fade out approaching this distance in metres. 0 never fades.
kit_row.label: Far cutoff m

kit_row.help: Relative depth step that counts as a silhouette. Used in Relative depth mode.
kit_row.label: Threshold

kit_row.help: Depth step in metres that counts as a silhouette. Used in Metric depth mode.
kit_row.label: Metric m

kit_row.help: Relative keeps one threshold working near and far. Metric uses real metres.
kit_row.label: Depth mode

kit_row.help: Inner lines where a smooth surface folds, like panel lines and cloth.
kit_row.label: Creases

kit_row.help: Strength of the crease lines.
kit_row.label: Crease amt

kit_row.help: Normal angle that counts as a crease. Lower catches every fold; higher keeps only hard corners.
kit_row.label: Angle deg

kit_row.help: Blends a second colour in along the edge or over time, or where motion peaks.
kit_row.label: Mode

kit_row.help: Secondary ink colour used by the colour modes.
kit_row.label: Second colour

kit_row.help: Colour cycles per second in the two-tone and rainbow modes.
kit_row.label: Cycle speed

kit_row.help: Cycle length along the edge in pixels at 1080p. 0 cycles over time only.
kit_row.label: Cycle px

kit_row.help: Everything, subject only, depth band, screen shapes and so on. Subject modes use the target below.
kit_row.label: Isolate

kit_row.help: Which Director cast subject to isolate.
kit_row.label: Target

kit_row.help: Draws the ink everywhere except the isolated region.
kit_row.label: Invert

kit_row.help: Half depth of the subject slab in metres, around the subject.
kit_row.label: Depth range m

kit_row.help: Feather distance beyond the slab, in metres.
kit_row.label: Depth feather

kit_row.help: Subject depth used when the target is not in the world.
kit_row.label: Fallback m

kit_row.help: Where the subject mask comes from in modes 1 to 3. Avatar tag needs the Enable avatar tag button in Infrared.
kit_row.label: Mask source

kit_row.help: Which candidates feed the target list in mode 3.
kit_row.label: Target set

kit_row.help: Mode 3: cap on how many targets are isolated at once, nearest first.
kit_row.label: Max targets

kit_row.help: Mode 3: the shape drawn around each target.
kit_row.label: Target shape

kit_row.help: Mode 3: each target gets its own palette colour.
kit_row.label: Per target

kit_row.help: Mode 4: near edge of the isolated depth band, in metres.
kit_row.label: Band near m

kit_row.help: Mode 4: far edge of the isolated depth band, in metres.
kit_row.label: Band far m

kit_row.help: How much the screen ellipse restricts the slab. 0 is depth only; 1 is fully.
kit_row.label: Ellipse mix

kit_row.help: Ellipse radius as a multiple of the subject's projected size.
kit_row.label: Ellipse size

kit_row.help: Ellipse edge softness, as a fraction of the radius.
kit_row.label: Ellipse edge

kit_row.help: Screen rectangle or ellipse centre, X (0 left, 1 right). Modes 7 and 8.
kit_row.label: Shape X

kit_row.help: Screen shape centre, Y (0 bottom, 1 top). Modes 7 and 8.
kit_row.label: Shape Y

kit_row.help: Screen shape half-width, as a fraction of the screen.
kit_row.label: Half width

kit_row.help: Screen shape half-height, as a fraction of the screen.
kit_row.label: Half height

kit_row.help: Wobbles the line and redraws it a few times a second, like inked animation.
kit_row.label: Hand-drawn

kit_row.help: How far the boil wobbles, in pixels at 1080p.
kit_row.label: Boil px

kit_row.help: Redraw rate. 12 is on twos; 8 is on threes.
kit_row.label: Redraw fps

kit_row.help: 0 gives big lazy undulations; 1 gives tight chatter.
kit_row.label: Wobble size

kit_row.help: How many times the line is drawn. 2 to 4 gives a sketchy bundle.
kit_row.label: Strokes

kit_row.help: Grain that breaks the line, for a dry pencil feel.
kit_row.label: Roughness

kit_row.help: Reshuffles the wobble and grain pattern.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: Overlays a repeating pattern on the line itself, independent of the boil.
kit_row.label: Pattern

kit_row.help: Dash period, dot spacing, hatch spacing or taper size, in pixels at 1080p.
kit_row.label: Size px

kit_row.help: Dash fill, dot size or double-stroke fraction, depending on the pattern.
kit_row.label: Ratio

kit_row.help: Scrolls dashes or dots along the edge, in pixels per second. Dashed and dotted only.
kit_row.label: Drift px/s

kit_row.help: Hatch stripe angle in degrees.
kit_row.label: Hatch angle

kit_row.help: Hatch only: a hatched shading zone inside the outline. 0 hatches the line itself.
kit_row.label: Shade px

kit_row.help: Hatch only: also draws the perpendicular stripe set.
kit_row.label: Cross-hatch

kit_row.help: Reshuffles the taper noise pattern.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: How the line's coverage animates. None leaves the line static.
kit_row.label: Style

kit_row.help: Cycles per second, or per beat when Tempo is set.
kit_row.label: Speed

kit_row.help: Motion depth. 0 leaves the line static.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Per-style scale: chase tail, scan bar width, wave count or shimmer density.
kit_row.label: Scale

kit_row.help: Per-style secondary parameter: duty cycle, reveal mode and so on.
kit_row.label: Shape

kit_row.help: Sweep, reveal or diagonal direction in degrees, for the styles that use an angle.
kit_row.label: Angle deg

kit_row.help: Reshuffles the hashed-frame styles: Strobe, Electric, Neon Buzz and others.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: A second animation multiplied onto the first. Same list as the first motion.
kit_row.label: Style

kit_row.help: Second motion speed, in cycles per second (or per beat under Tempo).
kit_row.label: Speed

kit_row.help: Second motion depth. 0 leaves it static.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Second motion per-style scale.
kit_row.label: Scale

kit_row.help: Second motion per-style secondary parameter.
kit_row.label: Shape

kit_row.help: Second motion sweep, reveal or diagonal direction, in degrees.
kit_row.label: Angle deg

kit_row.help: Scales every Roto Ink animation at once: both motions, boil, drift and colour cycle.
kit_row.label: Anim speed

kit_row.help: Freezes all Roto Ink animation on the current frame.
kit_row.label: Pause

kit_row.help: Also scales ink animation by the Director camera's Time speed, for slow and fast motion.
kit_row.label: Director time

kit_row.help: 0 uses cycles per second. Above 0, every motion speed becomes cycles per beat and locks to the tempo.
kit_row.label: Tempo BPM

kit_row.help: Offsets the beat clock, so several ink layers can sit on one tempo out of step. Tempo only.
kit_row.label: Phase beats

kit_row.help: Holds the motion clock to a stepped frame rate, for a hand-animated feel.
kit_row.label: Hold frames

kit_row.help: Sync Roto Ink to the Tron clock is set on the Tron page, its one home.
kit_row.label: Tron clock

kit_row.help: Opens the full Lightbox Roto Ink tab.
kit_row.label: Lightbox â€º
